name: inbound-form-intake
description: Turns contact, quote and lead form submissions into records, matches them to existing contacts, assigns an owner by your rules and lets them know, with spam left out.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: Your website form sends a submission to a webhook URL

howItWorks.label: Does
howItWorks.text: Creates the inquiry and finds or creates the contact, matched by email

howItWorks.label: Routes
howItWorks.text: Assigns an owner from your rules: quote requests to sales, support questions to support

howItWorks.label: Notifies
howItWorks.text: The owner in Slack, if you pick a channel

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve each set of record changes

plugins.reason: Tells the assigned owner about a new inquiry in a channel

data.description: What kind of request it is (quote, support, partnership, other)
The link from the inquiry to the contact who sent it
The team member responsible for following up
Which form or page it came from
The contact's email, used to find an existing contact
The contact's company, for B2B leads
Team members who can own inquiries, with their name and Slack handle if kept

parameters.label: Who gets what
parameters.default: Quote requests and wholesale questions go to sales. Order and product questions go to support. Everything else goes to the default owner.
parameters.description: Plain-language rules; name team members or teams as they appear in the project

parameters.label: Default owner
parameters.description: Who gets inquiries no rule matches; leave empty to leave them unassigned

parameters.label: Leave out spam
parameters.description: Obvious spam is not saved; it is counted in the run summary

parameters.label: Slack channel
parameters.description: Optional; where owners are told about new inquiries
